error_unknown: That didn’t work. Check what you entered and try again.
error_host_failed: Something went wrong on the host. Try again in a moment.
error_account_creation_failed: The PLC directory didn’t take the group’s new identity. Try again in a moment.
error_actor_not_found: There’s no account with that handle.
error_already_added: That key is already on the group’s identity.
error_already_deactivated: The group is already switched off.
error_already_here: That account is already on this host.
error_already_member: You’re already a member of this group.
error_bad_jwt: Your sign-in didn’t hold up. Sign in again.
error_blob_too_large: That file is too large for this host.
error_duplicate_name: You already have an app password with that name.
error_expired_request: This request has expired. Go back to the app and start again.
error_expired_token: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
error_forbidden: Your roles don’t let you do that.
error_group_not_found: There’s no group with that handle on this host.
error_handle_taken: That handle is taken. Try another.
error_host_key: The host’s own key can’t be removed.
error_internal: Something went wrong on the host. Try again in a moment.
error_invalid_archive: That archive isn’t whole. Export it again.
error_invalid_handle: That isn’t a handle this host can give out.
error_invalid_invite: That invite has expired or was cancelled.
error_invalid_key: That isn’t a key this host takes. Use a did:key for secp256k1 or P-256.
error_invalid_name: That name won’t work. Try another.
error_invalid_operation: Someone else changed the group’s identity at the same moment. Try again.
error_invalid_repo: That account’s repository couldn’t be read.
error_invalid_request: That didn’t work. Check what you entered and try again.
error_invalid_scope: One of those permissions isn’t one a space can grant.
error_invalid_site: The host can’t serve that site. Check its files and try again.
error_invalid_subject: That isn’t something in this group.
error_invalid_swap: Someone else changed this at the same moment. Reload the page and try again.
error_invalid_token: Your sign-in isn’t valid anymore. Sign in again.
error_join_closed: This group only takes people it invites.
error_last_configurer: You’re the only one who can run this group. Give someone else that role first.
error_no_own_domain: Give the group a handle on its own domain first.
error_not_a_member: You’re not a member of this group.
error_not_allowed: This host only starts groups for the people it names.
error_not_controller: This host no longer controls the group’s identity.
error_not_deactivated: The group is already switched on.
error_not_plc: Only an account with a did:plc can move here.
error_not_pointing: That domain doesn’t point at this group yet. Check its DNS record.
error_not_reaching: That domain doesn’t reach this host yet. Check its DNS records, then try again in a few minutes.
error_not_space_owner: That space isn’t the account’s own.
error_payload_too_large: That’s too large for this host.
error_rate_limit_exceeded: You’ve done that too often. Wait a few minutes and try again.
error_repo_not_found: There’s no group with that handle on this host.
error_reserved_space: That space belongs to the group itself and can’t be changed this way.
error_same_account: That’s the account you’re signed in with.
error_scope_missing: The app wasn’t given permission to do that.
error_sign_in_again: Your sign-in at your account’s server has lapsed. Sign in again.
error_space_already_exists: The group already has that space.
error_space_not_found: The group has no such space.
error_too_large: That’s more than this host takes at once.
error_too_many_app_passwords: You have as many app passwords as a group allows. Revoke one first.
error_too_many_keys: The group already has as many recovery keys as it can hold. Remove one first.
error_unknown_key: That key isn’t on the group’s identity.
error_unknown_role: One of those roles doesn’t exist.
error_unsupported_domain: This host can’t give out handles on that domain.
error_unsupported_policy: This host can’t keep a space with that policy.
error_untrusted_app: This host doesn’t start groups for that app.
error_upstream_failure: Your account’s server didn’t answer as expected. Try again in a moment.
group_site_read_blobs: Pictures and files in those posts
group_site_act_report: Report posts and members to moderators
group_site_act_join: Join the group, or ask to join
group_site_delete_body: Its pages at {#place/} go offline. Anyone who opens that address sees the group's page here instead.
group_site_empty_body: Publish a folder of web pages to put them online.
group_site_publish_intro: Choose the folder with your site's pages. Put the front page at the top, named index.html, and a 404.html beside it for addresses that aren't found.
group_site_publish_intro_replacing: Choose the folder with your site's pages. Put the front page at the top, named index.html, and a 404.html beside it for addresses that aren't found. This replaces the site that's there now.
group_site_fallback: Send every address to one page, for single-page apps
group_site_reads_legend: Let pages show the group's data
group_site_reads_body: Pages written to ask for these can show them to people who sign in, as far as the group lets each person see. Other pages stay as they are.
group_site_spaces_legend: Let pages show every post in a space
group_site_spaces_body: Pages that ask for these spaces see every post in them. People who sign in see only what the group lets them see. A key after a slash picks one space of the kind.
group_site_spaces: Kinds of space, one per line
group_site_acts_legend: Let pages act for people who sign in
group_site_acts_body: Pages can do these for people who sign in, in their name.
group_site_writes_legend: Let pages write in the group's spaces
group_site_writes_body: Pages written to make these can make them for people who sign in, in their own account, as far as the group lets each person write.
group_site_writes: Kinds of record, one per line
group_site_inbox_body: When someone signs in, the site makes the inbox where groups send them invites, if they don't have one yet.
review_dialog_press_label: Press one of the group's labels to add it.
review_dialog_labels_hint: Apps that follow the group's labels decide what each one does.
review_dialog_takedown_account_hint: Hides everything this account posted in the group's spaces, and asks apps that follow the group's labels to hide it too. They stay in the group.
review_dialog_takedown_hint: Hides this in the group's spaces, and asks apps that follow the group's labels to hide it too. The rest of what they posted stays.
review_dialog_takedown_account_body: The group's spaces stop showing what {#person/} posted, and apps that follow its labels hide it. Removing the label undoes it.
review_dialog_takedown_record_body: The group's spaces stop showing this {kind} by {#person/}, and apps that follow its labels hide it. Removing the label undoes it.
review_dialog_no_version: The queue doesn't know which version of this to label. Label it from a terminal, with {command} and its CID.
review_dialog_unreported: Nobody has reported them. Report them to put them in the queue, for you or another moderator to decide.
labels_editor_shown_hide: Apps hide it until someone chooses to see it.
labels_editor_shown_warn: Apps show it with a warning.
labels_editor_delete_body: Moderators can no longer choose “{name}”. What already wears it keeps it.
labels_editor_empty_body: A label says what moderators found, such as spam or off-topic, so apps can warn about it or hide it.
labels_editor_create_intro: Moderators pick it when they review an account or post. Creating one with a value already in use changes that label.
labels_editor_setting_hide: Hidden until someone chooses to see it
join_panel_invited_body: Someone in {group} invited you to join.
join_panel_asked_body: You'll be a member once someone approves it.
join_panel_invite_body: Ask someone in {group} to invite you. Your invite will show up here.
site_domain_empty_body: Change the group's handle to a domain you own. Then you can move its site there.
site_domain_on: Your site is at {#domainName/}. {#addressName/} sends visitors there.
site_domain_off: Your site is at {#addressName/} for now.
site_domain_move_back_label: Move the site back to its address
site_domain_move_title: Move the site to your domain
site_domain_move_intro: Add A and AAAA records for {#domainName/} and {#wwwName/}, with the same addresses as {#hostName/}. Once they work, your site moves to {#domainName/}, and {#addressName/} sends visitors there.
profile_form_town: Town or city it meets in
profile_form_topics_hint: Separate up to ten with commas, like climbing, choir or renters' union.
app_passwords_made: The app password “{name}” is {#password/}. Copy it now. You won't see it again.
app_passwords_revoke_body: Apps using “{name}” are signed out, and it stops working.
app_passwords_empty_body: Create one for an app that signs in with a handle and password, like the Bluesky app.
app_passwords_make_intro: You'll see it once, right after it's created.
group_handle_not_pointing: This domain no longer points to the group. Fix its _atproto record, or go back to the group's address.
group_handle_given: The address this host gave it.
group_handle_back_title: Go back to the group's address?
group_handle_back_body: The group's handle becomes {#given/} again in every app, and {#current/} stops being its handle.
group_handle_domain_intro: Type your domain, then add this record where you manage its DNS. New records can take a few minutes to show up.
authorize_request_mcp_wants: An AI app calling itself {#app/} wants to act as you in one of your groups.
authorize_request_mcp_unchecked: The app chose this name, and it isn't checked. It came from {#origin/}.
authorize_request_wants: {#app/} wants to sign in as one of your groups.
authorize_request_scopes: The app asks for these permissions (scopes):
authorize_request_mcp_roles: It could do what your roles there let you do ({roles}).
authorize_request_bare: The app would only know it's signed in as {group}.
authorize_request_no_role: You don't have a role in this group, so you can't sign an app in as it.
authorize_request_empty_title: No group you can sign it in as
authorize_request_empty_body: You don't have a role in any group on this host.
group_list_empty_title: You are in no group here yet
group_list_empty_body: Start one, or join one you are invited to.
account_move_taken: That address is taken. Try another.
account_move_here_own: Here it will be {#handle/}, its own handle.
account_move_copy_body: Everything in the account is copied here. Then its server emails you a code to finish the move.
account_move_copied: {#account/} is copied here. Its server has emailed a code to the account's email address.
connect_ai_app_ask_requests: Who is asking to join, and what did they say?
connect_ai_app_ask_queue: What is waiting in the moderation queue?
connect_ai_app_add: Add this address to your AI app as a connector
connect_ai_app_approve: When it asks, sign in here and approve it
connect_ai_app_acts: It acts for you in {group}, with what your roles let you do.
connected_apps_disconnect_body: {app} can no longer act for you here. You can connect it again later.
connected_apps_empty_body: Add the address above to an AI app, and it shows up here.
group_activity_empty_title: No app has written anything yet
group_activity_empty_body: When an app signed in as the group writes something, it shows up here.
group_apps_revoke_body: {app} can no longer act as the group. It can sign in again later.
group_apps_empty_title: No apps are signed in as this group
group_apps_empty_body: When a member signs an app in as the group, it shows up here.
invitations_empty_body: Invites from groups show up here.
invite_dialog_intro: They'll see it the next time they sign in, here or in any app that shows invites.
invites_empty_body: People you invite show up here until they join or decline.
join_requests_empty_body: Requests to join show up here.
links_editor_empty_body: Other places to find the group, like its chat or website.
member_list_roles_intro: Choose the roles {#person/} holds. Everyone keeps the member role.
member_list_remove_body: {#person/} loses access to what only members see. They can ask to join again.
member_list_empty_title: No member's handle has that in it
member_list_empty_body: Try fewer letters, or clear the search to see everyone.
moderation_queue_empty_escalated: What you escalate shows up here.
moderation_queue_empty_resolved: What you resolve shows up here.
new_group_form_address_hint: This is the group's handle and web address. You can change it.
new_group_form_description_placeholder: We meet monthly to talk about our favorite books 📚
profile_pictures_avatar_intro: A square picture, drawn round beside its name.
profile_pictures_banner_intro: A wide picture, three times as wide as it is high, across the top of its page.
recovery_keys_remove_body: The person who holds it can no longer use it to recover the group.
recovery_keys_add_intro: A key you hold. With it you can recover the group, or move it, without this host.
recovery_keys_add_goat: No key yet? Make one in a terminal with {#link}goat{/link}. Paste the public key it prints here, and keep the secret key somewhere safe.
recovery_keys_key: A key of yours, as a did:key
report_dialog_intro: {#person/} goes into the open queue with your report.
report_dialog_rule: The rule it breaks, if any
roles_editor_delete_body: People with this role lose what it lets them do. You can only delete a role nobody has.
roles_editor_create_intro: Choose what people with this role can do, and which roles they can give. You give roles to members from the group's page.
roles_editor_any_role: Any role, even ones made later
rules_editor_delete_body: “{rule}” will no longer be one of the group's rules, here or in other apps.
rules_editor_empty_body: A rule says what everyone in the group agrees to.
sign_in_dialog_title: Sign in with your Atmosphere account
switch_off_body: Nobody can see it, not even members, until an admin switches it back on.
visibility_public: Anyone, and it can be found
visibility_members: Members only. Others see just its handle.
visibility_hint: Hiding it stops new people finding it. It can't undo what people have already seen.
back_to_app_taking: Taking you back to the app… {#link}Go back to the app{/link}
back_to_app_unsafe: The app asked to be sent back somewhere it may not be.
delete_group_body: This deletes the group and everything in it for good. Members keep what they posted on their own accounts.
leave_guard_body: You’ll lose the changes you haven’t saved.
move_sign_in_body: You'll sign in to the account's server and let this host move it.
permissions_withheld: The app asked for this, and won't get it.
permissions_files: The app could upload files too.
permissions_manage: Manage the spaces, too: create them, and add and remove members.
pick_many_full: That's {most}, the most it can have. Remove one to add another.

match.countPlural=one: You're a member with the {roles} role.
match.countPlural=other: You're a member with the {roles} roles.

standing_body: You'll lose access to what only members see. You can ask to join again later.
switched_off_body: An admin can switch it back on.
route_error_400: Nothing was asked of this page
route_error_403: This is not yours to see
route_home_welcome_body: Sign in with your Atmosphere account to see your groups, or to start one.
route_authorize_expired_body: Go back to the app and try again.
route_authorize_sign_in_first: An app wants to sign in as one of your groups. Sign in first.
route_move_sign_in_first: Sign in first. You'll run the group it becomes.
route_move_not_allowed: This host starts groups only for the people it names.
route_move_intro: An account you already have, on any server, can move here to become a group you run. It keeps its DID, so whoever follows it still does, and its spaces come with it.
route_new_sign_in_first: Sign in first. You'll be the group's founder.
route_new_not_allowed: This host starts groups only for the people it names.
route_new_or_move: Or {#link}move an account you already have{/link} here, to become a group.
route_group_welcome_body: Sign in to see this group.
route_group_moderation_not_yours_title: Nothing here is yours to see
route_group_moderation_not_yours_body: Only people whose roles let them read the moderation queue can see it.
route_group_settings_not_yours_title: Nothing here is yours to change
route_group_settings_not_yours_body: Only people who run {group} can change its settings.
route_group_settings_handle_intro: The name the group goes by in Bluesky and other apps. Its address here, {#address/}, and its site keep working whichever you use.
route_group_settings_switch_off: Switch off or delete the group
route_group_settings_switch_off_intro: Switching the group off hides it from everyone until an admin switches it back on. Deleting it can't be undone.
route_group_settings_apps_activity: What apps did as the group
route_group_settings_apps_activity_intro: Each write an app made while signed in as the group, newest first.
route_group_settings_labels_intro: The labels moderators put on accounts and posts. Apps that follow the group's labels read what each means and how to show it.
route_group_settings_recovery_intro: Keys that can change the group's identity, highest ranked first. A key you hold can undo what this host does, or move the group elsewhere without it.
route_group_settings_recovery_none_title: This host keeps no keys here
route_group_settings_recovery_none_body: This host can't change this group's identity.
route_group_settings_recovery_lost: This host no longer holds a key to the group's identity, so it can't change the keys.
route_group_settings_roles_intro: What people with each role can do. You give roles to members from the group's page.
route_group_settings_rules_intro: Rules everyone in the group agrees to. They show on the group's page in this order.
route_group_settings_site_intro: Pages you publish here are open to anyone at {#address/}, signed in or not.
route_group_settings_site_domain_intro: Your site can be at the group's own domain instead of {#address/}.
permissions_email_manage: Read and update the group's email address
permissions_identity_full: Manage the group's full identity, including its @handle
permissions_account_status: Turn the group off for a while, and back on
permissions_bluesky_broad_private: Manage the group's profile, posts, likes and follows, and read its private preferences
permissions_bluesky_broad: Manage the group's profile, posts, likes and follows
permissions_bluesky_parts_private: Use parts of the group's Bluesky account, and read its private preferences
permissions_bluesky_parts: Use parts of the group's Bluesky account
permissions_bluesky_private: Read the group's private Bluesky preferences
permissions_bluesky_about: The app asks to do this on the Bluesky account:
permissions_set_unknown: A set of permissions this host does not know
permissions_repository_all: Create, update and delete any of the group's public data
permissions_repository_about: The group's repository holds its public data, such as its posts. The app asks to make these changes to it:
permissions_authenticate_any: Act as the group with any service
permissions_authenticate_other: Act as the group with other services
permissions_authenticate_about: The app asks to call these methods as the group:
permissions_spaces_about: Spaces, such as group chats and shared calendars, hold data only their members can see. The app asks for this access:
permissions_warning_spaces: It asks for every space on the network. Only allow this for an app you trust completely.
permissions_warning_identity: It asks for full control of the group’s identity, so it could break the group’s account or take it. Only allow this for an app you trust completely.
forms_failed: That didn’t work. Check what you entered.
forms_host_failed: Something went wrong on the host.
saving_failed: That didn’t save. Check what you entered.
settings_country_needed: Choose the country the town is in.
settings_topics_too_many: A group can list up to {count} topics.
settings_links_too_many: A group can have up to {count} links. Remove one first.
settings_site_folder_needed: Choose a folder with the pages of your site in it.
settings_site_spaces_bad: Write each line as a type of space, with /key after it to pick one space.
settings_site_writes_bad: Write each line as a type of space, with /key after it to pick one space, and a kind of record, with a colon between.
settings_domain_not_reaching: {domain} doesn't reach this host yet. Check its DNS records, then try again in a few minutes.
settings_domain_no_own: Give the group a handle on its own domain first.
settings_handle_not_pointing: {handle} doesn't point to this group yet. Check its _atproto record, then try again in a few minutes.
route_authorize_no_request: This page is for an app signing in, and no app asked.
shell_sign_up_unreachable: We couldn't reach {host} to make an account. Try again in a moment.
shell_sign_in_not_found: We couldn't find {handle}. Check your handle and try again.
